review.posthog_relevance: Adds transient error classification and retry handling for Meta Ads batch subrequests, allowing the ingestion pipeline to recover from transient abort errors rather than failing immediately.
review.reason: Adds a new transient error classification and retry handling for Meta Ads batch subrequests. P1.F1.H1 introduces a new error code and retry behavior; P1.F1.H2 adds a counter and retry loop; P1.F1.H3 checks for transient errors before processing. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement for the ingestion pipeline, distinguishing transient failures from permanent
review.uncertainty: The actual production benefit and recovery rate improvement are not demonstrated by the code alone; this score reflects the implementation of the retry and classification mechanism, not its outcome.
